decision_conditions: The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the local planning authority.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:&nbsp;<span style="line-height: 107%;">Form 4 – Reasonable Exception Statement, PL-A-01,
PL-A-02, PL-A-03, PL-A-04, PL-A-05, PL-A-06, TH 5020.</span>
The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
The window and door in the flank elevation of the proposed development facing towards Tall Trees, Thornton Grove shall be of purpose-made obscure glass, and shall thereafter be retained in that form.

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify; margin-bottom: 0cm;"><span style="line-height: 107%;">Prior to the commencement of works hereby approved,
a photographic record of all tree and ground protection measures has been
implemented in accordance with the Arboricultural Impact Assessment, Method
Statement &amp; tree Protection Plan (TH 5020) that would be forwarded to the Arboricultural
consultant shall be submitted and approved in writing by the Local Planning
Authority. The tree protection measures shall be retained until completion of
all works hereby permitted.<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><o:p></o:p></span></font></span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify; margin-bottom: 0cm;"><span style="line-height: 107%;">The development hereby permitted shall not be
occupied until there has been submitted to, and approved by, the local planning
authority, a scheme of hard and soft landscape works which shall include a
survey of all existing trees and hedgerows on the land, indicating those to be
retained and those to be lost. Soft landscape works shall include: planting
plans, and schedule of plants, noting species, plant sizes and proposed
numbers/densities. The landscaping details as approved shall be retained after
completion of all works hereby permitted.<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><o:p></o:p></span></font></span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify; margin-bottom: 0cm;"><span style="line-height: 107%;">The Arboricultural Method Statement and Tree
Protection Plan (Ref: TH5020) hereby approved must be adhered to in full. The
tree protection measures shall be retained until completion of all works hereby
permitted.<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><o:p></o:p></span></font></span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify; margin-bottom: 0cm;"><span style="line-height: 107%;">All planting, seeding or turfing comprised in the
approved details of landscaping shall be carried out in the first planting and
seeding seasons following the occupation of the building(s), or the completion
of the development, whichever is the sooner. Any existing or new trees or
shrubs which, within a period of 5 years from the completion of the
development, die, are removed, or become seriously damaged or diseased, shall
be replaced in the next planting season, with others of a similar size and
species, unless the local authority agrees any variation in writing.<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><o:p></o:p></span></font></span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify; margin-bottom: 0cm;"><span style="line-height: 107%;">None of the existing trees (except for the trees
labelled on the approved plans) on the site shall be lopped, topped, felled or
uprooted without the prior written permission of the local planning authority.
Any topping or lopping which is approved shall be carried out in accordance
with British Standard 3998 (Tree Work).<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><o:p></o:p></span></font></span></p>
description: Front porch, Conversion of garage to habitable room, Replacement of garage door with window in front elevation, Two storey side extension, Two storey front, side to rear extension, Single storey rear extension, Replacement windows and doors in front and rear elevations, Roof lights in rear roof slope, Extension to rear patio, External alterations (Demolition of ground floor rear bay window)
